Traditional Vietnamese iced coffee made with strong, dark-roast drip coffee and sweetened condensed milk.
(Iced) A bold brew with a ripe banana-twist—unexpectedly smooth and naturally sweet.
A smooth and creamy latte made with our District 1 coffee and coconut crema for a tropical, indulgent twist.

At Phin Smith, every cup starts with bold, intentional flavor rooted in Vietnamese coffee traditions. We source beans from Vietnam’s renowned coffee regions, from the cool, temperate mountains of Da Lat to the Central Highlands, areas blessed with natural beauty and nutrient-rich soil.

From the smooth balance of our Saigon Blend made with 100% Da Lat Arabica to the bold intensity of our District 1 Roast combining Central Highland Robusta with Arabica, each brew tells a story. Discover how we bring Vietnamese coffee culture to every sip.

Named after Quan Nhat in Saigon, our District 1 blend is a combination of Robusta beans from the central highlands of Vietnam balanced with Arabica beans for a smooth, rich flavor. This blend offers the best of both worlds. The bold intensity of Vietnamese Robusta harmonized with the refined smoothness of Arabica for a perfectly balanced cup.

A tribute to the coffee culture in Saigon, our "Saigon Blend" is made with 100% Arabica beans grown in the cool, temperate mountains of Da Lat, a region blessed with natural beauty and nutrient-rich soil. This exceptional terroir produces a bold, yet rich, smooth flavor that captures the essence of Vietnam's finest coffee tradition.

sources.title: About – Phin Smith
paragraphs: Phin Smith is more than a coffee shop—it’s a collective of baristas, roasters, thinkers, students, artists, and recipe makers brought together by a shared passion for crafting memorable coffee experiences. We come from different backgrounds, but we’re united by a love of flavor, culture, and connection. But Phin Smith isn’t about us—it’s about you. Whether you’re chasing your next creative spark, pausing in the middle of a busy day, or simply craving something new, we hope every experience with us inspires you to travel, to discover, to learn, and ultimately, to find your cup.

We believe in slowing down. In the quiet power of a thoughtful brew. In the way travel opens hearts and coffee opens conversations. The inspiration behind our menu comes from the places we’ve been and the people we’ve met—recipes discovered abroad, stories shared over cups, and moments that remind us to savor life. Every drink we make is infused with that spirit: a blend of curiosity, reverence, and celebration for global cultures. At Phin Smith, every sip tells a story. We can’t wait to share them with you.
